evals.name: model-rap-cds-root-and-child
evals.prompt: Model a sales order and its line items for a RAP app using CDS view entities. I need a root, a child association, and amount/currency semantics.
evals.expected_output: Uses view-entity syntax, models the root-child relationship with a composition/association appropriate to RAP, and includes suitable amount and currency semantics without using legacy define view syntax.

evals.name: route-standalone-sql-query
evals.prompt: Write an ABAP SQL query with GROUP BY and a window function to calculate per-customer ranking. I don't need a CDS entity.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as an ABAP SQL request and routes to the abap-sql-amdp skill rather than designing a CDS data model.
